node.statement: Lemma A.1 (Adjoint of purification channel): For |u> in C^d tensor C^r, Phi^{d,r,dag}(Schur^{tensor 2} |u><u|^{tensor n} Schur^{tensor 2,dag}) = sum_lambda (dim(lambda)/dim(V_lambda^r)) |lambda><lambda| tensor I_{dim(lambda)} tensor nu_lambda^d(sigma_u). Proof: From the Kraus decomposition of the purification channel and Lemma 3.2 (pure state in double Schur basis), compute the adjoint action. The key: the adjoint traces out the ancilla Specht and Weyl registers, leaving a weighted sum over lambda sectors.
